name: ZETRIX
recent: Zetrix AI 近期因未支付 RM25m 的伊斯兰债券（sukuk）款项而被 MARC 下调评级至违约，并确认于 11 月 6 日违约，承诺进行结算。政府就 RM314m 的 JPJ 欠款提起诉讼，但法律程序随后被撤回，公司仍维持暂停派息。公司获得 Bursa Securities 额外两天时间披露财务状况与股息问题。
notable: MARC 将 Zetrix AI 的 sukuk 评级下调至违约，涉及未支付的 RM25m。
公司确认于 11 月 6 日发生 RM25m sukuk 违约，并承诺进行结算。
政府就 RM314m 的 JPJ 欠款提起诉讼，但法律程序已被撤回。
risks: 公司发生 RM25m sukuk 违约，MARC 已下调评级至违约。
政府就 RM314m 的 JPJ 欠款提起诉讼（随后撤回）。
公司暂停派息，并因披露问题获得 Bursa Securities 延期。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM426.7m，环比增长 10.5%，同比增长 38.6%；净利为 RM269.3m，环比下降 0.8%，同比增长 35.2%；净利率为 63.1%，低于上一季度的 70.2%。

recent_en: Zetrix AI was downgraded to default by MARC over an unpaid RM25m sukuk obligation, confirmed the default on Nov 6, and committed to settlement. The government sued over RM314m in JPJ arrears, but the legal proceedings were subsequently withdrawn, and the company maintained its dividend freeze. It secured a two-day extension from Bursa Securities to disclose information on its financial position and dividend issues.
notable_en: MARC downgraded Zetrix AI's sukuk to default over an unpaid RM25m.
The company confirmed the RM25m sukuk default on Nov 6 and committed to settlement.
The government sued over RM314m in JPJ arrears, but the legal proceedings were withdrawn.
risks_en: The company defaulted on a RM25m sukuk, and MARC downgraded it to default.
The government sued over RM314m in JPJ arrears (later withdrawn).
The company froze dividend payments and obtained an extension from Bursa Securities over disclosure issues.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM426.7m, up 10.5% QoQ and 38.6% YoY; net income was RM269.3m, down 0.8% QoQ but up 35.2% YoY; net margin was 63.1%, lower than 70.2% in the previous quarter.
